mapper.select: select i.id, i.tenant_id, i.account_id, a.username, i.issuer, i.subject, i.linked_by, i.linked_at from batch.console_external_identity i join batch.console_user_account a on a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and a.id = i.account_id where i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by i.linked_at desc, i.id desc

select i.id, i.tenant_id, i.account_id, a.username, i.issuer, i.subject, i.linked_by, i.linked_at from batch.console_external_identity i join batch.console_user_account a on a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and a.id = i.account_id where i.account_id = #{accountId} and i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into batch.console_external_identity (tenant_id, account_id, issuer, subject, linked_by) values (#{tenantId}, #{accountId}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{linkedBy})
mapper.delete: delete from batch.console_external_identity where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
